function.name: set_reminder
function.description: Reminds the user at a time: the pet appears and says the task aloud.

task.description: What to do, short, in the user's language. Malayalam uses the 'to do' form, e.g. 'അമ്മയെ വിളിക്കാൻ'.

repeat.description: Only when the user asks for a repeating reminder.

minutes_before.description: Early warning in minutes, only when the user asks for one.

function.name: set_alarm
function.description: Sets a wake-up alarm at a time, or a countdown timer for a duration.

duration.description: Timer length, e.g. '10 minutes', '1 hour 30 minutes'.

function.name: cancel_reminder
function.description: Removes a reminder, alarm or event. Words from it, or 'all'.

function.name: show_plan
function.description: Reads out the reminders, events and lists for a day.

day.description: 'today', 'tomorrow', a weekday like 'monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Default 'today'.

function.name: create_event
function.description: Adds an event to the phone's calendar.

title.description: Short title in the user's language.

function.name: save_note
function.description: Saves something the user wants remembered: a note, a fact, where something is kept, a birthday.

text.description: The fact, short, in the user's language.

function.name: find_note
function.description: Looks up something the user earlier asked Milo to remember.

question.description: What they want to know, short.

function.name: add_to_list
function.description: Adds items to a list such as shopping or to-do.

list.description: 'shopping', 'to-do', or the list name the user says.

items.description: Each item separately, in the user's words.

function.name: send_message
function.description: Prepares a WhatsApp or SMS message; the user taps Send.

contact.description: The person, as the user says them, in the basic form: 'അമ്മ', 'Amma', 'mom', 'Rahul'.

message.description: The exact message to send, in direct speech, in the language the user wants.

app.description: whatsapp unless the user says SMS.

function.name: send_email
function.description: Prepares an email; the user taps Send.

to.description: Name, relation or email address as said.

function.name: call_contact
function.description: Opens the call screen for a contact; the user confirms.

contact.description: The person in the basic form, as in send_message.

app.description: phone unless the user says WhatsApp.

video.description: true only for a video call.

function.name: share_location
function.description: Prepares a WhatsApp message with the user's current location.

contact.description: The person in the basic form.

function.name: save_contact
function.description: Remembers who a family member or friend is.

function.name: open_app
function.description: Opens an installed app.

app.description: App name in English, e.g. 'YouTube', 'WhatsApp', 'Google Pay'.

function.name: phone_setting
function.description: Turns a phone setting on or off.

function.name: navigate
function.description: Opens Maps with directions.

function.name: play_media
function.description: Plays a song, video, playlist or radio.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Searches the web and opens the results.

function.name: phone_status
function.description: Tells the current time, date, day and battery level.

function.name: remember_name
function.description: Saves the name the user wants to be called.

function.name: emergency_help
function.description: Danger or a medical emergency: shows the emergency number 112 and starts a call to a saved family member.

situation.description: A few words about what is happening.
